welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: To get started, scan the invite QR code from the person who runs your family's budget, or open the link they sent you.

unreachable.title: Can't reach your budget
unreachable.body: Check your connection and try again.

outdated.title: Your budget needs an update
outdated.body: This version of the app expects a newer database. Ask the person who runs your family's budget to update it.

incomplete.title: This link is incomplete
incomplete.body: Scan the QR code again, or ask whoever invited you for a new one.

switch.title: Switch to a different budget?
switch.body: This device is connected to {{current}}. The link you opened would connect it to {{next}} instead, and sign you out here.
switch.trust: Only switch if you trust whoever sent you the link.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Ask the person who runs your family's budget to reset it.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.name: Your name
signUp.inviteOnce: Your invite works once. If you already have an account, <signIn>sign in</signIn> instead.

alreadySignedIn.title: You're already signed in
alreadySignedIn.body: This device is signed in as {{email}}. To create a new account with this invite, sign out first.

errors.unreachable: Can't reach your budget. Check your connection.
errors.inviteRejected: This invite code is invalid, already used or expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.emailTaken: There's already an account with this email.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.

dashboard.netWorthPlaceholder: The all-time net worth chart goes here.
dashboard.upcomingPlaceholder: Recurring transactions waiting to be paid go here.

errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.

about.title: About you
about.name: Name
about.displayCurrencyHint: Totals across currencies are shown in this one.

spaces.explained: Your private space and the spaces you share with others.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.unexpected: The app hit an unexpected error.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.privateExplained: Only you can see this space. It can't be shared, renamed or deleted.
spaces.name: Name
spaces.notFound: This space doesn't exist, or you're not a member of it.

members.title: Members
members.lastMember: You're the last member, so you can't leave this space.

delete.title: Delete space
delete.explained: A space can be deleted only while it holds no transactions other than opening balances.

errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete this space. Check your connection and try again.
errors.nameBlank: A space's name can't be blank.

account.currencyChanged: {{actor}} changed the currency of “{{name}}” from {{from}} to {{to}}

openingBalance.set: {{actor}} set the opening balance of “{{account}}” to {{amount}}, as of {{date}}
openingBalance.changed: {{actor}} changed the opening balance of “{{account}}” to {{amount}}, as of {{date}}

category.deletedAndMoved_one: {{actor}} deleted the category “{{name}}” and moved its transaction to “{{to}}”
category.deletedAndMoved_other: {{actor}} deleted the category “{{name}}” and moved its {{count}} transactions to “{{to}}”
category.movedUnderDeleted: {{actor}} moved “{{name}}” under a category since deleted

accounts.none: No accounts yet. Add one to start tracking your money.
accounts.noneShown: No accounts in the spaces you're viewing.
accounts.notFound: This account doesn't exist, or it's in a space you're not a member of.

form.name: Name
form.currencyFixed: An account's currency can't change once it has transactions.
form.openingBalanceHint: What the account held on the date below. Use a minus sign for a debt, like a credit card's.
form.currencyChanged: Enter the opening balance again, in {{currency}}.

archive.title: Archive
archive.explained: Archived accounts are hidden from lists but keep their history, and still count in totals.
archive.stillHolds: {{name}} still holds {{balance}}. Archived, it still counts in totals.
archive.isArchived: This account is archived: it's hidden from lists, but still counts in totals.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.explained: An account can be deleted while its opening balance is its only transaction. The opening balance is deleted with it.
delete.hasTransactions: This account has transactions, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead.

errors.nameBlank: An account's name can't be blank.
errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete this account. Check your connection and try again.

categories.title: Categories
categories.notFound: This category doesn't exist, or it's in a space you're not a member of.

form.name: Name
form.parentFixed: A category with subcategories stays at the top level.
form.kindFromParent: A subcategory has its parent's type.
form.kindForSubcategories: Its subcategories change type with it.

delete.title: Delete category
delete.explained: A category's transactions move to another category of the same type in this space when it's deleted.
delete.hasSubcategories: This category has subcategories, so it can't be deleted. Move or delete them first.
delete.hasTransactions_one: {{name}} has {{count}} transaction. Choose where it goes.
delete.hasTransactions_other: {{name}} has {{count}} transactions. Choose where they go.
delete.nowhereToMove_one: {{name}} has {{count}} transaction, and there's no other category of its type in this space to move it to. Add one first.
delete.nowhereToMove_other: {{name}} has {{count}} transactions, and there's no other category of its type in this space to move them to. Add one first.

errors.nameBlank: A category's name can't be blank.
errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete this category. Check your connection and try again.
errors.saveRefused: Couldn't save this change. The categories may have changed meanwhile; reload and try again.
errors.deleteRefused: Couldn't delete this category. The categories may have changed meanwhile; reload and try again.
